channels.r: approximate distance to rasterized OSM shoreline / 100m, capped at 1
channels.g: OSM coastline land mask: 1 land, 0 water

uv: u=(x-minX)/(maxX-minX); v=(z-minZ)/(maxZ-minZ); texture invertY=true for v=0 south
distanceAccuracy: Distance-transform approximation at approximately 68x57m regional pixels; use local shore-distance.png for fine Zhanqiao shoreline.
